title: The Garden Party
objectives_ko: 글자 M~Z 14개의 이름과 소리를 빠르게 말한다
M~Z로 시작하는 단어 42개를 듣고 그림을 고른다
사이트워드 we, like, can, you, go, to, look, at, this, here를 보고 읽는다

panels.desc: A garden party on the lawn under the blooming letter trees, with paper lanterns and a long picnic table. On the table: a milk carton and glass, a bowl of hot soup, a bowl of white rice, a cup of strawberry yogurt, a plump tomato, a glass of orange juice. Bun ties a bunch of nine colorful balloons to the table; Hedgie carries a tray; Pip sings on a branch with little golden notes. Party guests: the queen swan with her golden crown, the panda, the monkey, the otter dancing. Hidden in the picture: the milk, the soup, the rice, the yogurt. Grumble does NOT appear at the party — only the faint shape of his hill in the far background with a bright lantern light.

Grumble's burrow at the foot of the hill. Grumble sits in the mouth of his dirt hole hugging his lantern, which shines as bright as a star. Hedgie holds out a gift box wrapped in red paper with a yellow ribbon; Bun points back toward the party lanterns; Pip hops on the rim of the hole chirping a tiny golden note. Hidden in the picture: the gift, a toy rocket lying by the hole, the bandaged pink worm peeking from the grass.

lines.text: Can you go to the party?

panels.desc: At the party. Grumble has opened the gift — a small drum — and sits in the middle of the lawn happily beating it with two sticks, nightcap bouncing, a big grin on his face, his lantern hanging from a tree branch above him glowing like a star-lamp. Pip sings on the drum rim; Bun and Hedgie dance; the queen swan, the panda, the zebra and the yak clap along. Hidden in the picture: the queen swan, the panda, the zebra, the yak.

Sunset over the party. Everyone — Bun, Hedgie, Pip, Grumble with his drum and all the animal guests — stands at the garden fence looking up: a single glowing golden seed with a tiny leaf has lifted off from the last letter tree and is flying up and over the wooden fence toward a blue pond glimmering in the distance beyond. Bun points after it; Hedgie holds his flower; Pip flutters up after the seed; Grumble's lantern on the fence post shines like a star. Hidden in the picture: the smiling sun setting, an open brown box of party hats by the fence, a red umbrella leaning on the fence.

lines.text: It can go up, up, up!
